cards.title: Act Like You Belong
cards.instruction: You do not understand what is happening. Copy the confidence around you and never admit confusion.

cards.title: Talk Around the Mess
cards.instruction: Keep attention on minor details so no one addresses the larger responsibility you avoided.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You've put a red label on your box, so I've put red on all mine. Should I underline the names too?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Red means fragile. Your boxes haven't even been packed.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Exactly, fragile contents. We need clear writing before anything goes in. Is that underline thick enough?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The moving van's outside. We need to fill the boxes.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Take this label out to the man first. Ask if he can read it from the van; I don't want our things going to the wrong room.

reason: Use concrete copied misunderstandings to shape control, quiet restoration, detail diversion, protective handling or inquiry, with each B contribution changing A's next move.
